concept: Neon mouth over a tiled bathhouse
creativeDirection: A glazed ceramic mural transforms the album motifs into a luminous modernist bathhouse wall, led by a giant tongue-shaped fountain mask and supported by graphic figural and emblematic tiles.
scene: A frontal wide view into an empty indoor bathhouse, centered on a monumental tiled wall above a shallow reflecting pool.

elements.element: The stylized angular yellow face becomes the main wall mask on the left side of the mural, built from bold ceramic colour fields with dark blue incised facial lines, green hair tiles, a red ear tile, and a small red circular eye accent.

The multicoloured tongue-and-lips emblem becomes the dominant central fountain spout, oversized and cropped by the frame, with glossy gradient glaze flowing from blue through purple, red, orange, and yellow.
The white stylized flower appears as repeated simple tile inlays and one larger medallion reflected in the water, set against deep moss-green glazed sections.

The group of five young people becomes a single horizontal procession of five simplified full-body mosaic figures along the lower wall, posterized into saturated blocks of colour, each distinct and readable but secondary to the fountain mask.

The whimsical vintage collage imagery becomes decorative border tiles and floating bathhouse ornament: butterflies, birds, tiny airships, stars, circular cameos, and abstract outlined shapes woven through the upper frieze and corners.

mood: playful, graphic, surreal, sun-warmed, slightly reverent

coverSummaries.description: A bold, stylized portrait of a human face fills most of the square. The face is rendered in flat yellow with sharp dark blue angular lines forming the features, a small red circular eye detail, green hair, and a red ear. Torn-paper-like blocks of red, yellow, green, and white sit against a dark blue background, creating a collage effect.
coverSummaries.medium: graphic illustration with cut-paper collage styling

coverSummaries.description: A large tongue-and-lips graphic dominates the right side on a plain white background. The tongue shape is cropped by the frame and filled with a smooth gradient shifting from blue at the top through purple and red to orange and yellow at the bottom, with white teeth above and a golden-yellow outline around the form. The composition is clean and minimal.

A simple white flower emblem with a rounded bloom, stem, and two leaves is centered on a dark, softly mottled green background. The flower is flat and stylized, with black internal line details. The overall layout is sparse and symmetrical.

Five young people are posed shoulder-to-thigh across the cover against a white background, treated with high-contrast, posterized colour. A woman in the center stands forward with arms out, wearing a cropped long-sleeve top and plaid skirt. Around her are two women and two men in casual 1990s-style clothing, including a sleeveless sports jersey, cardigan, and dark fitted outfits. The image has a bright, saturated, cutout-photo look.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: group of five young people posed in a row

coverSummaries.description: A dense, whimsical collage spreads across a light cream background. Large outlined lettering-like shapes weave through the center, surrounded and filled with many small images and symbols: butterflies, birds, a dirigible, biplanes, stars, circular portraits, flowers, abstract blobs, and decorative fragments. The composition is busy and scattered, mixing black outlines with multicoloured accents and vintage-style cutout imagery.
coverSummaries.signatureMotif: surreal collage of small vintage-style images around large outlined forms

prompt: Frontal wide view into an empty indoor bathhouse, centered on a monumental tiled wall above a shallow reflecting pool; a giant tongue-and-lips fountain mask dominates the composition at center-right, projecting from the wall with glossy teeth above and a smooth rainbow tongue glaze shifting from blue through purple and red to orange and yellow; on the left, a bold angular yellow face formed from ceramic tile fields, with dark blue incised features, green hair, a red ear, and a small red circular eye, occupies most of the upper wall; along the lower wall runs a secondary procession of five distinct young people rendered once only as simplified mosaic figures in posterized 1990s-style clothing, arranged shoulder-to-thigh in a shallow row beneath the larger icons; integrate a white stylized flower as one large medallion and several smaller tile inlays on deep green sections, and weave source-inspired details from vintage collage imagery into the bathhouse architecture as decorative friezes and corner ornaments: butterflies, birds, tiny dirigibles, biplanes, stars, circular cameo medallions, flowers, and abstract outlined forms; glazed ceramic mural with hand-cut tiles, majolica-like glossy surfaces, visible grout lines, subtle kiln variation, and crisp graphic contours; strong visual hierarchy with the tongue fountain first, angular face second, figures third, ornamental borders last; balanced asymmetrical composition, bright overhead clerestory light reflecting in the pool, clean architectural perspective, no text; palette of cobalt blue, sunlit yellow, moss green, white, scarlet, violet, orange, cream, and black; mood playful, graphic, surreal, and quietly ceremonial. Hard constraints (override any conflicting source material): Create a single cohesive 16:9 image, not a grid, contact sheet, row of covers, or collage of separate panels. Do not reproduce the album sleeves as framed thumbnails; transform their non-text visual motifs into one original composition. Include no readable text or lettering of any kind: no words, letters, numbers, code, glyphs, captions, titles, logos, watermarks, labels, or signage. Feature only adults and avoid gore, wounds, body horror, medical or anatomical imagery, blank or milky eyes, nudity, sexual content, weapons, and hate symbols; reinterpret any sensitive source motif abstractly. When a source includes a person, closely match their visible appearance and likeness to the reference image, preserving recognisable facial features, hair, skin tone, clothing, and styling. Depict each identifiable reference person only once in the entire composition; do not repeat or clone them as another figure, reflection, mirror portrait, poster, billboard, screen, photograph, painting, silhouette, or background face. The only exception is repetition visibly intrinsic to one source cover: keep that repetition within that single source motif and do not echo the person elsewhere.
